effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [Counter] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 [Paishu] Token. (Digimon/Yellow/6000 DP/＜Blocker＞ ＜Guard＞)
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon are played, ＜De-Digivolve 2＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash up to 2 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, 1 of their Digimon gets -6000 DP until their turn ends.
